hero_title: Memory that stays useful—and knows when to forget
hero_subtitle: A server-owned pipeline turns user messages into traceable facts, refreshes a concise profile, and retires stale information automatically.
pipeline_capture_desc: Inspect the new user message after it is saved.
pipeline_resolve_desc: Add, confirm, supersede, or forget atomic facts.
pipeline_age_desc: Review changing facts and expire stale ones by policy.
pipeline_include_desc: Give the chat model the complete bounded profile on every turn.
chat_subtitle: Send a message to see the profile and fact history update.
empty_chat_body: Introduce yourself, share a preference or project, correct an old detail, or ask the system to forget something.
sample_identity: My name is Maya, and I live in Berlin.
sample_project: I'm building a solar-powered garden sensor.
sample_change: I moved from Berlin to Hamburg last month.
message_placeholder: Tell the assistant something worth remembering…
memory_subtitle: See what is stored, its source and confidence, and when it will be reviewed.
demo_warning: Local single-user demo — do not expose it publicly.
profile_empty: The profile will appear after the first durable fact is captured.
architecture_body: Immutable message evidence supports versioned atomic facts. Their complete bounded profile is included on every turn without search.
policy_stable_desc: Review yearly; expire after three years without fresh confirmation.
policy_slow_desc: Review periodically and strengthen only with new user evidence.
policy_changing_desc: Review soon and supersede when a newer value is explicit.
policy_ephemeral_desc: Keep briefly, then expire automatically unless confirmed.
dialog_forget_body: This removes the fact from active memory while keeping a deletion event in the demo timeline.
dialog_reset_body: All demo messages, facts, profile versions, and timeline events will be deleted.
dialog_simulate_body: Advance the demo clock to show how review and expiry policies affect memories.
toast_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
status_memory_connection_failed: Could not reach OpenAI after retrying
mode_note_live: Messages update memory through the configured OpenAI model.
mode_note_simulation: No API calls are made. A deterministic local simulator updates memory.
offline_ack_with_memory: I'll keep that in mind. Complete memory: {facts}
offline_ack_without_memory: Got it. I'll use the context from this conversation.
offline_fact_project: The user is building a solar-powered garden sensor.
mode_note_unconfigured: Add OPENAI_API_KEY to the demo .env file or enable simulation mode.
